title: Flashing folder with question mark
shortDescription: Mac cannot find a bootable system.
fullDescription:
A flashing folder with a question mark icon at startup means your Mac cannot find a valid macOS startup disk. This can be caused by selected startup disk being unset, a corrupted system, or a failed SSD.

On Intel Macs, holding Option at startup brings up a list of available startup disks. On Apple Silicon, hold the power button to enter recovery mode.

causes.cause: Startup disk not selected in System Settings

fixSteps.title: Select startup disk
fixSteps.instruction: Intel: Power off, hold Option while powering on, choose Macintosh HD. Apple Silicon: Hold power button, choose Macintosh HD in startup options.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall macOS
fixSteps.instruction: Boot to Recovery (Cmd+R Intel, hold power Apple Silicon) and reinstall macOS.

fixSteps.title: SSD replacement (Intel only)
fixSteps.instruction: Older Intel MacBooks have replaceable SSDs; modern ones have soldered storage.

whenToCallPro: If reinstall fails — soldered SSDs require Apple service.
videoSearchQuery: MacBook flashing folder question mark fix

faq.a: Reinstall preserves data unless you erase the disk.

title: Prohibitory symbol at startup
shortDescription: macOS version not compatible with this Mac.
fullDescription: A prohibitory sign (circle with diagonal line) appears at startup when the Mac finds a system but the macOS version on the disk does not support that hardware. Common after restoring from another Mac's backup or installing wrong macOS via USB.

fixSteps.title: Boot to Recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Cmd+R (Intel) or hold power (Apple Silicon) to enter recovery.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall correct macOS
fixSteps.instruction: From Recovery, reinstall macOS. Use Internet Recovery (Cmd+Opt+R) for the latest compatible version.

title: Flashing battery / low battery icon
fullDescription: MacBook displays a flashing battery icon when battery is too low to start. Connect MagSafe / USB-C adapter and charge for at least 30 minutes before pressing power.

fixSteps.title: Connect charger
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in original Apple charger and let charge 30+ minutes.

fixSteps.title: Try different cable
fixSteps.instruction: If charging LED doesn't light, swap MagSafe cable or USB-C cable.

fixSteps.title: Service battery
fixSteps.instruction: If battery shows Service Battery in System Report, replacement is needed (Apple service).

whenToCallPro: For battery replacement — they're glued in modern MacBooks.

title: SMC (System Management Controller) reset
fullDescription: On Intel MacBooks, the SMC manages power, battery, fans, sleep/wake. Resetting it fixes many oddities: not charging, fans always on, won't power on, sleep issues. Apple Silicon Macs do not need SMC reset.

fixSteps.title: Intel MacBook with T2 chip
fixSteps.instruction: Shutdown, hold Right Shift + Left Option + Left Control for 7 seconds, then add power button for another 7 seconds. Release all and start.

fixSteps.title: Older Intel MacBook (non-removable battery)
fixSteps.instruction: Shutdown, hold Left Shift+Control+Option+Power for 10 seconds. Release and start normally.

fixSteps.title: Apple Silicon
fixSteps.instruction: Just shut down for 30 seconds and reboot — no SMC.

title: NVRAM / PRAM reset
shortDescription: Reset stored settings (volume, display, startup disk).
fullDescription: NVRAM stores small settings like volume, display resolution, startup disk, and time zone. Resetting it fixes display issues at startup, sound problems, and incorrect startup disk. Intel only.

fixSteps.title: NVRAM reset (Intel)
fixSteps.instruction: Shutdown, press power, immediately hold Cmd+Option+P+R for 20 seconds (you'll hear chime twice or Apple logo appears twice).

fixSteps.title: Apple Silicon
fixSteps.instruction: NVRAM auto-resets when needed; no manual reset available.

faq.a: No, just settings like volume and startup disk.

title: Service Battery warning
fullDescription: macOS shows 'Service Battery' or 'Service Recommended' when battery health drops below 80% of design capacity or detects a fault. Battery still works but won't last long.

fixSteps.title: Check Battery Health
fixSteps.instruction: System Settings > Battery > Battery Health (i icon) — note Maximum Capacity and Service status.

fixSteps.title: Apple battery service
fixSteps.instruction: Visit Apple Store or AASP for battery replacement. Cost ~$130-$250 depending on model.

fixSteps.title: Third-party replacement (out of warranty)
fixSteps.instruction: iFixit or shops can replace battery on most models, but Apple Silicon MacBooks have glued batteries and serial-locked components — service complex.

faq.a: Yes but expect short runtime and possible shutdowns.

alternativeCodes: You need to restart your computer
title: Kernel panic - restart your computer
fullDescription: Kernel panic is macOS's equivalent of a BSOD. Screen darkens with restart message in multiple languages. Common causes: bad RAM, third-party kernel extensions, GPU faults, or corrupted system updates.

fixSteps.title: Check panic log
fixSteps.instruction: After restart, System Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data — look for panic log to identify the kext.

fixSteps.title: Boot to Safe Mode
fixSteps.instruction: Apple Silicon: hold power, choose disk + hold Shift. Intel: hold Shift while booting. Test in Safe Mode for stability.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall macOS
fixSteps.instruction: Boot to Recovery and reinstall over existing system.

faq.a: Same concept — system caught an unrecoverable error.

title: Display flicker or artifacts
shortDescription: Pink/green lines or flicker on Mini-LED displays.
fullDescription: Some MacBook Pro 14/16 (M1/M2 Pro) Mini-LED displays show pink or green flicker, especially when waking from sleep. Apple has addressed many issues via macOS updates.

fixSteps.title: Update macOS
fixSteps.instruction: System Settings > General > Software Update — install latest.

fixSteps.title: Toggle ProMotion
fixSteps.instruction: System Settings > Displays > set Refresh Rate to 60Hz to test. If flicker stops, ProMotion driver issue.

fixSteps.title: Apple service for panel
fixSteps.instruction: If hardware confirmed, AppleCare can replace the display assembly.

whenToCallPro: If software fix doesn't help — under AppleCare.
videoSearchQuery: MacBook Pro 16 display flicker pink fix

title: macOS update failed
fullDescription: MacBook updates fail with 'An error occurred installing macOS' or get stuck at progress bar. Common causes: insufficient disk space, broken update package, low battery during install.

fixSteps.title: Free up space
fixSteps.instruction: Boot to Recovery, open Disk Utility, check free space. macOS needs 20GB+ for updates.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall via Recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Cmd+R (Intel) or hold power (Apple Silicon), Reinstall macOS.

fixSteps.title: Configurator restore
fixSteps.instruction: If totally bricked, use another Mac with Apple Configurator 2 to restore (Apple Silicon).

faq.a: Reinstall preserves data unless you erase.

title: Touch Bar frozen / black
fullDescription: MacBook Pro Intel models with Touch Bar sometimes have the Touch Bar freeze, go black, or stop responding. A simple Terminal command restarts the Touch Bar service.

fixSteps.title: Restart Touch Bar
fixSteps.instruction: Open Terminal, run: sudo pkill TouchBarServer

fixSteps.title: SMC reset
fixSteps.instruction: Reset SMC if frequent.

fixSteps.title: Service if hardware
fixSteps.instruction: If Touch Bar shows artifacts or never works, Apple service required.

videoSearchQuery: MacBook Pro Touch Bar frozen fix

faq.a: Only MacBook Pro 13 M1/M2; 14/16 dropped it.

title: Sticky / repeating / dead keys
fullDescription: MacBook Pro/Air models from 2016-2019 use the butterfly keyboard which is prone to stuck, repeating, or dead keys due to dust under the key dome. Apple offered a free Keyboard Service Program.

fixSteps.title: Compressed air clean
fixSteps.instruction: Hold MacBook at 75 degrees, blow compressed air across the keyboard from left to right, then top to bottom.

fixSteps.title: Apple Keyboard Service Program
fixSteps.instruction: Apple may still cover affected models — check Apple Support article.

fixSteps.title: Top-case replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Out of program: top case (keyboard + battery + speakers) replacement, expensive.

whenToCallPro: If air cleaning doesn't resolve — Apple service program.
videoSearchQuery: MacBook butterfly keyboard sticky keys fix

faq.a: 2020+ MacBook Pro use Magic Keyboard — much more reliable.

title: Flexgate - backlight failure at hinge
shortDescription: Vertical bright bands at bottom of MacBook Pro display.
fullDescription:
Flexgate (or 'stage light' effect) is a known defect on 2016-2018 MacBook Pro 13/15 where the display backlight cable wraps around the hinge and wears out from repeated opening/closing. Symptoms appear at the bottom of the screen and worsen as the lid opens further; eventually the backlight fails entirely.

Apple ran a free repair program for affected 13-inch models.

causes.cause: Worn display flex cable at hinge

symptoms: Backlight cuts out at full open angle

fixSteps.title: Check Apple repair program
fixSteps.instruction: Apple's 13-inch MacBook Pro Display Backlight Service Program covers free repair for affected serials.

fixSteps.title: Display assembly replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Out of program: full display assembly replacement (cable is integrated). Costly.

videoSearchQuery: MacBook Pro flexgate stage light fix

faq.a: Apple lengthened the cable in 2019, dramatically reducing the issue.
